Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Tata Memorial Centre recruitment is Genetic Counsellor. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Genetic Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Genetic Counsellor post in this recruitment drive by Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this TMC recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with their documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Genetic Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Genetic Counsellor position is Rs. 25,506 Per Month. This is a consolidated monthly salary.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Genetic Counsellor role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Life Sciences/Genetics/Genetics Counselling with at least 3 years of relevant experience, or a Post Graduate Degree in Genetic Counselling.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Genetic Counsellor post is 45 years. No age relaxation details are provided.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date for the TMC Genetic Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the TMC Genetic Counsellor recruitment is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates must report on this date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the TMC Genetic Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the TMC Genetic Counsellor recruitment. This applies to all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview for the TMC Genetic Counsellor post going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Tata Memorial Centre office in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, with the pincode 842004.
